About the FAMAS | Styx

A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has individual parts spray-painted khaki and grey. The FAMAS | Styx is a Restricted-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Styx finish on the FAMAS. With a Restricted rarity classification, it has approximately a ~3.2% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The FAMAS | Styx can be unboxed from the ESL One Cologne 2014 Cache Souvenir Package, DreamHack 2014 Cache Souvenir Package, ESL One Katowice 2015 Cache Souvenir Package, ESL One Cologne 2015 Cache Souvenir Package, DreamHack Cluj-Napoca 2015 Cache Souvenir Package, MLG Columbus 2016 Cache Souvenir Package, Cologne 2016 Cache Souvenir Package, Atlanta 2017 Cache Souvenir Package, Krakow 2017 Cache Souvenir Package, Boston 2018 Cache Souvenir Package, London 2018 Cache Souvenir Package and Katowice 2019 Cache Souvenir Package. It belongs to the Cache Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.60. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The FAMAS | Styx (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $107.43, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $15.70 (Battle-Scarred) to $107.43 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The FAMAS | Styx has a community rating of 3.5 out of 5 based on 268 votes. This mixed rating suggests the design appeals to some players while others prefer alternative finishes.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the FAMAS | Styx?

Factory New (FN) FAMAS | Styx skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Styx pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the FAMAS | Styx worth the price?

The FAMAS | Styx sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Styx design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Cache Collection, obtainable from the ESL One Cologne 2014 Cache Souvenir Package, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the FAMAS, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the FAMAS | Styx?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.60, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the FAMAS | Styx?

Prices for the FAMAS | Styx vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the ESL One Cologne 2014 Cache Souvenir Package or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the FAMAS | Styx in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the FAMAS | Styx are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the FAMAS | Styx price going up or down?

The FAMAS | Styx has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the FAMAS | Styx from?

The FAMAS | Styx is part of the The Cache Collection. It can be obtained by opening the ESL One Cologne 2014 Cache Souvenir Package. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the FAMAS | Styx?

The in-game description reads: "A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has individual parts spray-painted khaki and grey." The Styx finish on the FAMAS is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.

Do professional CS2 players use the FAMAS | Styx?

Yes, 1 professional CS2 players currently have the FAMAS | Styx in their inventory. Pro player adoption is a strong indicator of a skin's prestige and desirability in the community, and can positively influence its market value.
